title: Investigation of the Asymptotic Properties of Active Impedance in Large Finite Array Antennas
summary: This paper presents an improved full-wave solver for finite array antennas, and uses this solver to examine asymptotic properties of active impedance for large regular arrays. The improved solver is based on a preconditioning scheme that has been adapted for use on more general finite geometries, and an improved data structure. These two improvements result in a fast and stable solver with a lower memory footprint.
